'''Rootmass Cysts''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawned by all [[Rooter (Disambiguation)|Rooters]] after receiving damage.

== ''Behavior'' ==

* Rootmass Cysts take damage from nearby [[Rooter (Disambiguation)|Rooters]] and reroute it to themselves.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Rootmass Cysts, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
